events.subtitle: feat. Jon Faddis, James Carter & ELEW
events.factual_description: Smoke Jazz Club presents Steve Turre's All-Star Sextet from September 16 through September 20, 2026, featuring Jon Faddis, James Carter, ELEW, Peter Washington, and Orion Turre. Smoke lists 6:30 PM and 8:30 PM sets throughout the residency, plus 10:00 PM sets on Friday September 18 and Saturday September 19. The venue specifically frames Turre as a modern master of trombone and seashells and emphasizes the distinctive instrumental voices of Faddis, Carter, and ELEW.

provenance.note: Dates, venue, lineup, showtimes, billing, and authorized ticketing were verified on Smoke Jazz Club's exact event page. Exact Apple Music album pages were verified independently. en.why_it_matters: This clears S because the lineup concentrates several unmistakable instrumental languages in one small-room ensemble: Turre's trombone and shells, Faddis's high-register trumpet lineage, Carter's huge tenor vocabulary, and ELEW's percussive piano, with Peter Washington anchoring the bottom. It is not a generic all-star label; the point is the collision of strongly individual voices around a master whose sound is immediately identifiable.
en.trip_verdict: S. Worth a dedicated DMV-to-New York trip for one set if brass, reeds, groove, and instrumental identity are central to the night. It stays below S+ because the booking is a five-night residency rather than a singular farewell, premiere, or one-off historical event.

es.why_it_matters: Cruza a S porque concentra varios lenguajes instrumentales inconfundibles en un ensamble de sala pequeña: el trombón y las conchas de Turre, la trompeta agudísima y de linaje Dizzy de Faddis, el vocabulario enorme de tenor de James Carter y el piano percusivo de ELEW, con Peter Washington sosteniendo el fondo. No es una etiqueta vacía de 'all-star': el acontecimiento es el choque de voces muy personales alrededor de un maestro cuyo sonido se reconoce de inmediato.
es.trip_verdict: S. Sí vale un viaje dedicado DMV→Nueva York por uno de los sets si metales, saxofón, groove e identidad instrumental son el centro de la noche. Se queda debajo de S+ porque es una residencia de cinco noches y no una despedida, estreno o acontecimiento histórico de una sola función.

events.subtitle: Patternmaster — ECM Records New York release
events.category: Contemporary jazz / New York record release
events.factual_description: Smoke Jazz Club presents Mark Turner's quartet from September 30 through October 4, 2026 for the New York release of the ECM album Patternmaster. The announced quartet is Turner, Jason Palmer, Joe Martin, and Jonathan Pinson, the same personnel credited on the 2026 recording. Smoke lists 6:30 PM and 8:30 PM sets throughout the residency, plus 10:00 PM sets on Friday October 2 and Saturday October 3, and identifies the engagement as Turner's Smoke debut as a leader.

recommended_listening.title: Patternmaster

provenance.note: Dates, venue, lineup, showtimes, record-release context, and authorized ticketing were verified on Smoke Jazz Club's exact event page. Patternmaster was verified on its exact Apple Music album page. The repository and current curated inbox were searched before publication; no Mark Turner event or batch was present.

en.why_it_matters: This clears S because Turner is one of the rare tenor players whose syntax is recognizable almost immediately, and Patternmaster is not a repertory vehicle: it is the current working quartet's new ECM document. The pianoless trumpet-tenor front line with bass and drums leaves harmonic responsibility distributed across the ensemble, which makes Turner's long-form phrasing and Palmer's contrasting brass voice especially exposed. The New York release and Turner's first Smoke leader engagement give this residency a concrete reason to choose this date rather than any generic Turner appearance.
en.trip_verdict: S. Worth a dedicated regional New York trip for listeners who care about tenor language, collective improvisation, and contemporary quartet architecture. It remains below S+ because the release engagement spans five nights and is part of an active working-band cycle rather than a singular historical event.

es.why_it_matters: Cruza a S porque Turner es uno de los pocos tenoristas cuya sintaxis se reconoce casi de inmediato, y Patternmaster no es un vehículo de repertorio: es el documento nuevo en ECM de su cuarteto de trabajo actual. El frente sin piano de trompeta y tenor, con bajo y batería, reparte la responsabilidad armónica por todo el ensamble y deja especialmente expuestos el fraseo largo de Turner y la voz contrastante de Palmer. El lanzamiento neoyorquino y el debut de Turner como líder en Smoke dan una razón concreta para escoger esta residencia y no cualquier fecha rutinaria del saxofonista.
es.trip_verdict: S. Sí vale un viaje regional dedicado a Nueva York para quien siga lenguaje de tenor, improvisación colectiva y arquitectura contemporánea de cuarteto. Se queda debajo de S+ porque el lanzamiento ocupa cinco noches y pertenece al ciclo activo de una banda de trabajo, no a un acontecimiento histórico singular.
